title: Comprehensive Network Map Schema
description: Centralized mapping schema for all network, certificate, routing, and NetworkPolicy translations from EKS to GKE.

class_mappings.description: Maps EKS GatewayClasses, IngressClasses, or custom controllers to GKE GatewayClasses/Ingress Classes.

certificates.description: Maps AWS ACM certificate ARNs or EKS Secret names to Google Cloud Certificate Manager names or GKE TLS Secret names.

domain_mappings.description: Optional mapping to rename hostnames/domains during migration (e.g., to redirect DNS to GKE endpoints).

cidr_mappings.description: Maps AWS VPC IP blocks (used in NetworkPolicies) to Google Cloud VPC / GKE Subnet IP blocks.
